notes.title: New DLC released
notes.content:
Hey guys, the day has come. The global update that I promised is finally out. As I promised here you will find a lot of updates, new levels and in general the game has been completely redesigned. I really hope that my labours will not be wasted and you will like my new vision of the game more than what was before. I highly recommend starting the game from the beginning as all the old levels have also been redesigned.

List of global changes:
 - 20 cool new levels
 - 2 new bosses
 - 1 new ranked enemy
 - New achievements (although this may not be an improvement for you)
 - New types of traps and obstacles
 - Story added to the game. Beautiful comics drawn by professional illustrators and also added voice acting to these comics. Now you are not just playing a game but you are playing a game with an interesting story.
 - New starting logo
 - All level textures were completely redrawn from scratch.
 - Also all navigation and menus within the game have been completely redesigned

What has been fixed:
 - A new smooth camera for the main character has been added
 - Base enemies became smarter
 - some bugs on boss fights have been fixed
 - The mechanics of the main character's jumps have been completely redesigned
 - Added a menu that allows you to reset your current progress and start the game again.
 - And much - much more

I've worked very hard on this add-on and it's all been for you. Your support and criticism has pushed me forward and pushed me to new heights, allowing me to get the game to the point where I can finally be happy with it. Thank you for supporting me and thank you for buying the game. I really appreciate it. Thank you for everything. Alex

notes.title: The new update upcoming [dev log] - new levels, bosses etc.
notes.content:
Hey, guys. I come to you with good news. I'm glad to tell you that I finally found time and started working on new levels for my game. While developing this game I didn't expect anyone to like it, I got feedback from you both positive and negative and all of it was very helpful, because feedback from real people helps us to get better and improve our skills and most importantly the product. Thank you for that, I really appreciate your opinion and thank you for buying my game and adding it to your Wishlists (there are already more than 2000 of them). Realizing that someone likes what I do makes me happier.

I would like to tell you what's in store for you in the future update:
 - 20 new levels
 - 2 new bosses
 - 60 new achievements
 - new enemies
 - new traps
 - better visual design of new levels
 - bug fixes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311037/d2ce85577215f7c5d44bb723a494a2e80edd2e71.png[/img]

I also want to say that this update will be absolutely free. So far I have only completed the first three levels but I will do my best to finish the add-on as soon as possible. Thanks for playing my game
